description: April 14 birthday meaning: Aries decan 3, birthday number 5, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, an April 14 birthday falls in Aries, in the third decan, with Mars as the sign's ruler and Jupiter as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 5. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Aries is cardinal and fire.

sections.heading: April 14 zodiac sign and personality
paragraphs: Fourteen reduces to 5, numerology's traveller, and the Jupiter-sub-ruled decan of Aries already favours exploration. April 14, about twenty-four degrees into the sign, is often read as one of the year's most freedom-loving birthdays: restless, curious and enthusiastic, with a horizon that keeps moving further away as soon as it is reached.

On April 14 the Sun usually sits at about 24° Aries, in the third decan, where Jupiter is the sub-ruler alongside Mars. The last ten degrees of Aries fall under Jupiter, the planet that governs Sagittarius, so this decan is usually read as the most philosophical version of the Ram. The urge to act is joined by an urge to understand why, and to go further, physically or intellectually. Astrologers tend to describe these mid-April birthdays as restless explorers who argue for principles as hotly as for themselves. Jupiter can widen the horizon and also the to-do list, so enthusiasm may outrun follow-through. At its best, this decan mixes Aries nerve with a broad, hopeful outlook that makes other people braver about their own plans.

sections.heading: April 14 in numerology
paragraphs: A 14th birthday reduces as 1 + 4 = 5, giving a birthday number of 5. The compound blends the 1's independence and the 4's structure into the 5's love of change, which makes for an interesting push and pull: a wish for freedom alongside a need for order. Some traditions also count 14 among the karmic debt numbers, linked with learning moderation. Fourteenth-born people are often described as versatile and quick to adapt, especially when they have a stable base to return to. This secondary number tends to reward balance over excess and variety with an anchor.

The Life Path, the main number in a numerology chart, also uses the birth year, so it changes from one April 14 birthday to the next: it is 7 for 1960, 8 for 1970, 9 for 1980 and 1 for 1990, for example. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11.

sections.heading: Born on April 14: season, famous birthdays and Chinese zodiac
paragraphs: April birthdays arrive in full northern spring, with lengthening days and fast growth; in the southern hemisphere the month belongs to mid-autumn and harvest. Aries carries most of April, handing over to Taurus around April 19 or 20. As month 4, April brings numerology's number of structure, steadiness and hard work, a grounding counterweight to the quick fire of the month's early birthdays. April 14 is the 104th day of the year (105th in a leap year). By April 20, 6 days later, the Sun has usually moved on into Taurus.

For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by April 14, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year. Well-known people born on April 14 include Arnold J. Toynbee (1889), King Faisal bin Abdulaziz Al Saud (1906) and Adrien Brody (1973).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is April 14?
faq.answer: April 14 is Aries in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the third decan of Aries, which tradition links with Jupiter.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on April 14?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On April 14 the Life Path is 7 in 1960, 8 in 1970, 9 in 1980, 1 in 1990, 11 in 2000, 3 in 2010 and 4 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 5 for everyone born on the 14th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on April 14?
faq.answer: Chinese astrology is straightforward for an April 14 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on April 14?
faq.answer: April 14 is also the birthday of Arnold J. Toynbee (1889), King Faisal bin Abdulaziz Al Saud (1906) and Adrien Brody (1973). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
